'''Head Coaches of the [[Hamilton Tigers (NHL)|Hamilton Tigers]] and the [[Quebec Bulldogs]]'''

as the Quebec Bulldogs:

* [[Charles Nolan (hockey coach)|Charles Nolan]] 1910–12
* [[Joe Malone]] 1912–17
* [[Mike Quinn (ice hockey)|Mike Quinn]] 1919–20 (as Quebec Athletics)

as the Hamilton Tigers:

* [[Percy Thompson]] 1920–22
* [[Art Ross]] 1922–23
* [[Ken Randall]] 1923–24
* [[Percy LeSueur]] 1924
* [[Jimmy Gardner (ice hockey)|Jimmy Gardner]] 1924–25
